subject.title: [Feature]: LINE requireMention should optionally gate non-text messages (with bounded pending-media retention)

question: Should LINE expose opt-in non-text mention gating together with a configurable in-memory pending-media retention queue?
rationale: This adds two public config fields and a new retention and fallback contract beyond established LINE behavior, without prior maintainer approval in the related discussions.

options.title: Adopt bounded retention
options.body: Review the linked PR after it proves media cleanup, queue lifecycle, compatibility, and live LINE behavior.

options.title: Gate without retention
options.body: Add only opt-in non-text gating and explicitly document that skipped media is discarded.

options.title: Keep current passthrough
options.body: Continue processing non-text media when LINE cannot provide mention metadata.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded retention
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR after it proves media cleanup, queue lifecycle, compatibility, and live LINE behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current LINE mention-gating contract and are the strongest available history-backed owner for the product-direction choice.
